scope: Candidate11 formal native ordinary/source only: all 16 completed theme/zoom/width combinations, six targets each.
method: Individually opened all 96 original X11 PNGs and 8 original paired WebView PNGs with view_image. Completion JSON selected eligible combinations only; visual findings came from the displayed pixels. SHA-256 was calculated after viewing. No UI, tests, builds, image transforms or screenshot changes were performed.
findings: All 96 selected source markers are visible. The reviewed literal syntax and Chinese target text are readable in both themes, with no observed missing-glyph boxes or target-marker occlusion.

At 200% narrow in both themes, the long root formula source extends beyond the right edge. The horizontal scrollbar is visible. The formula tail is outside this capture; accessibility of that tail was not exercised by this review.

Header/menu/status elements visibly scale together with the editor. Narrow high-zoom path labels are ellipsized. Neighboring content may meet or cross the vertical viewport boundary while the selected target remains visible.
The 8 sampled WebView captures visually agree with their X11 application regions. Black area outside the app in X11 screenshots is desktop background.
These are source-mode images of literal TeX, Mermaid and footnote markup. They do not demonstrate rendered MathML/vector/footnote preview correctness.
uncovered: Dynamic focus, keyboard or pointer behavior and horizontal-tail reachability
Saved bytes, undo/redo integrity, renderer lifecycle, disabled-plugin recovery and the full native run outcome
reviewStatus: Completed requested source-mode pixel review; horizontal-overflow boundary retained, no additional target readability issue observed.
